channel.title: Atlas Codex - Writings & Field Notes
channel.description: An evolving archive of essays, observations, diagrams, and working papers from the Atlas Codex of Living Systems.

item.title: On the Difference Between Knowledge and Understanding
item.description: Knowledge accumulates; understanding transforms. The distinction matters for how we approach learning and action.

item.title: Soil Temperature Observations, Year Three
item.description: Continuous monitoring reveals patterns invisible to casual observation. The soil remembers what the air forgets.

item.title: Feedback Loops in Small Communities
item.description: The same patterns that stabilize ecosystems also stabilize human groups. Recognizing them changes how we build institutions.

item.title: Preliminary Diagrams: Water Flow Patterns
item.description: Water reveals landscape. Careful observation of flow patterns shows us what contour maps cannot.

item.title: What Failure Teaches
item.description: The curriculum of failure is more reliable than the curriculum of success. This has implications for how we learn.
